properties.description:
Cut 2026-10-03 on Anthony's word ("Release first": release today's fixes so flo2.io can move onto them before the three-agent trial). Ships #649-#668 and the merge train #669 (#662, #663, #665, #666): the fix program accepted from the triage of the VS Code --call field report (2026-10-02), and the dependency-currency work.

MINOR, and THE SCHEMA STAMP MOVES by one enum value: Verification.last_reconciled_outcome gains `blocked` (#662). 28 node types and 66 edge types are unchanged. AN UPGRADE NOTE IS OWED: docs/upgrading-to-v0.78.0.md.

WHAT A CONSUMER OR OPERATOR SHOULD KNOW:
- Upgrade every seat together. Measured at this cut: a v0.77.0 binary does NOT refuse a design storing `blocked`; it opens it with no warning, re-stamps it 0.77.0, and writes an export v0.77.0 cannot import (fact:an-older-binary-opens-a-design-storing-a-non-indexed-enum-value-it-does-not-know-and-restamps-it-2026-10-03). The value is written only when reconcile_verification records the outcome `blocked`.
- Arguments that were ignored are now refused, naming the tool and the field path (#654, #656, #658): a wrong type, an unknown key, a value outside its set, an argument to one of twelve no-argument tools, a flag a one-shot mode does not read. --read-only is honoured by --call and by every forwarding client.
- Reply shapes: external_dependency replies with a receipt (read the manifest with reconcile_dependencies); detect_defects has the new category refused_by_schema; search_design and topic_report add `searched`; find_tools adds `describe`.
- --call: a writing call keeps the committed export current (exit 3 = written, export not; --no-export for bulk writes); in a folder naming a server design, --call and --export refuse; a read where there is no design refuses.
- New: reflow2 read / reflow2 write, --describe, --list-tools, get_node include_edges.
- Operators: RocksDB 10.4.2 -> 11.8.1 (stores open unchanged; v0.77.0 reads what 0.78.0 wrote, 20 stores measured); a --read-only server with no store creates nothing and answers /readyz 503; a shared server inherits nothing from its launcher (stop old ones with --stop-shared). Source builds need Rust 1.98.
